说明: 样板出图所用提示词与绿幕约定，用于同风格复现与后续扩产。运行 build.py 前需把 AI 原图放入 raw_ai/ 并使用相同文件名。

绿幕约定.背景: 纯平色 #00B140，覆盖到画面四周边缘，主体不接触画面边界
绿幕约定.切图阈值: 绿色主导度 G-max(R,B)：≤26 全不透明，≥92 全透明，中间线性羽化；边缘同时做去绿溢色

style_anchor: Japanese light semi-realistic 2D commercial illustration, soft cel shading, warm daylight from the left side, natural body proportions, restrained blue-white palette with small gold accents only, clean refined lineart, no text
ILL-S05: Mobile game background art, EMPTY office interior scene, no people: a small modern startup office in Japanese light semi-realistic 2D commercial illustration style, soft painterly shading, warm daylight streaming in from a large window on the LEFT side, casting bright warm light patches across a wooden floor toward the lower right, cool blue-grey shadows on the right side. Composition: large window with city skyline on the left half, a long light-wood desk in the lower left foreground with a closed laptop, coffee cup, pen holder and paper stack, a low sideboard with a small plant and a framed abstract picture on the center wall, a tall green potted plant at the far right edge. The RIGHT THIRD of the frame must stay visually calm and uncluttered (plain warm wall, soft floor) so a character can be composited on the right. Restrained blue-white palette with warm cream light and tiny gold accents, cinematic depth, subtle grain. Absolutely NO text, NO lettering, NO signage, NO logo, NO watermark, NO people, NO charts, NO UI elements, NO buttons.

头像扩产规则.取景: 沿用 auto_head_crop：头高占画幅约 70%，顶留 6%，肩部自然入画；24 格全部使用同一取景常数
头像扩产规则.身份组: 8 组 × 3 配色：01 男短发 / 02 女齐肩发 / 03 男卷发 / 04 女短发 / 05 男眼镜 / 06 女马尾 / 07 男背头 / 08 女长发
头像扩产规则.配色差异: 配色 1/2/3 只改西装与内搭的蓝系深浅，肤色、五官、发型不变，保证同一角色可被认出
头像扩产规则.禁止: 不要在同一 ID 上改动性别、发型长度或脸型
